title: Cryptic
body:
![Title logo of Cryptic](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d33f20f33983e36803a48b14700c5c3197df96a.png)

Cryptic is an in-depth revamp of Minecraft's currency system done by adding a complex and dynamic new trader with great skill in managing finances.

As of now, Cryptic contains:
- The Shillager, a new money-savvy Villager who will show up every once in a while for a chat
- A diverse stock market system accessed through the Shillager, encouraging vigilant investing
- A deep and storied lore that tells the tale of the Shillager's dark backstory...

# DISCLAIMER
This entire datapack is satire! It is not an endorsement nor criticism of NFTs and their economic, cultural, and environmental impacts. It is all a joke for April Fools', and it will not be maintained regularly.
